units.summary: New test helper that opens a DB with compactions disabled and fills its head with N series of in-order samples, committing every 10k series. It is test-only and cannot affect production.
units.headline: Benchmark helper builds head with N series of samples
units.reason: Test-only helper used by benchmarks; no production effect.

units.summary: New test helper that picks count refs at even intervals across the slice, or copies the whole slice when count >= len. Test-only.
units.headline: Helper samples refs evenly for benchmarks
units.reason: Small test-only helper; no production code path.

units.summary: New benchmark that rebuilds a 100k-series DB on every iteration (with the timer stopped) and times CompactSelectedSeries for several selected fractions. Benchmark-only.
units.headline: Add benchmark for CompactSelectedSeries across selection fractions
units.reason: New benchmark code; cannot change production behavior.

units.summary: New public DB method that copies the caller's refs, sorts and dedups them, and drops series that have OOO data. It then writes the remaining series into blocks tagged FromSelectedSeries, one per chunk range, and evicts them from the head under a watermark taken from the append ID. Triggered, failed and duration metrics are updated.

issues.title: Skipped count includes unknown refs, logged as OOO skips
issues.failure_scenario: The caller passes refs for series that were already GC'd from the head. filterSeriesAndSortPostings drops them, and the log reports them as num_skipped_ooo, so operators get a misleading OOO skip count.

units.headline: New CompactSelectedSeries persists and evicts chosen head series
units.reason: New public API that writes blocks and evicts head series under the compaction lock: a data-loss and concurrency risk.
focus: Watermark check in truncateSelectedSeries prevents evicting series that got samples after the snapshot, including when isolation is disabled
The OOO check runs before the block write; a series that receives OOO data between filtering and eviction must not be evicted
Error paths after some blocks were already written leave consistent state (blocks on disk, series still in head)
inOrderBlocksMaxTime and the planner exclude FromSelectedSeries blocks so WAL replay doesn't drop data

units.summary: New test that compacts a head holding a single sample on a chunk-range boundary and checks that one block is written and the series is evicted. Test-only.
units.headline: Test single-timestamp head is compacted and evicted

units.summary: New test that checks nil or empty refs are a no-op: no blocks are written and the triggered counter stays at zero. Test-only.
units.headline: Test empty ref list is a no-op
